description: TITLE SEARCH ONLY (not full-text): finds Japanese national laws, cabinet orders, and ministerial ordinances whose TITLE matches a keyword (e-Gov 法令検索). PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Japanese law on X", "日本の法律", finding a statute's official id/number. A query that only appears in the body of a law (not its title) will not match. Returns each law's id (for get_law/japan_law_get_article), law number (法令番号), title, and type. Accepts Japanese or romanized keywords.

query.description: Title keyword, e.g. "個人情報" (personal information), "労働基準" (labor standards).

name: search_laws
title: Search Laws
